# Sources for bottled_waters_v0.csv

Every URL used to fill a row (and the URLs that were tried and failed, so nobody repeats them), grouped by market and brand. Retrieval date for every entry: 2026-09-14.

Line format: `URL — retrieved 2026-09-14 — provenance_flag — what it gave`.

Provenance flags: `brand_site` (brand's or brand owner's own page/PDF), `label_photo_official` (label text or official technical sheet reproduced on a retailer/distributor page), `official_regulator` (regulator document — DGEG Portugal, ANM/LAMIN Brazil), `third_party` (compilation site; used only where nothing official exists).

Sections: Brazil (BR) · United States (US) · United Kingdom + Germany (GB, DE) · France + Italy (FR, IT) · Portugal (PT) · Additions made during the merge.


---

## United States (US)

Method note: WebFetch cannot read PDFs, so every PDF was downloaded with curl and converted with `pdftotext -layout` (scanned PDFs read visually). Several Primo Brands/BlueTriton sites (deerparkwater.com, arrowheadwater.com, purelifewater.com, water.com, acquapanna.com) sit behind Akamai and return 403 to plain fetches; they were fetched with full Safari request headers or in Chrome to obtain the PDF links. Web search budget for the session ran out after ~35 brands; remaining brands were probed by direct URL only.

- https://a-us.storyblok.com/f/1021132/x/42c82ed95d/polandspring_wqr_2025_en.pdf — retrieved 2026-09-14 — brand_site — 2025 Water Analysis Report (Spring Water + Sparkling columns; full mineral table with ranges).

## Portugal (PT)

Note on "Mineralização total": Portuguese labels print the sum of ions + silica as "Mineralização total"; it is stored in tds_mg_l with a units_notes flag on every row. "Resíduo seco a 180 °C" goes to dry_residue_180c_mg_l when printed.
Note on DGEG Hidrogenoma (hidrogenoma.dgeg.gov.pt): run by the Direção-Geral de Energia e Geologia, the Portuguese mineral-water regulator. Treated as official_regulator (analogue of ANM in the spec). It prints only mineralização total, pH, temperature and conductivity per water, plus captação name/location — used mainly for source_name/source_location cross-references.
